snippet.title: The Last Caretaker | XBOX Announcement Trailer & 1.0 Roadmap Reveal - Spring 2027
snippet.description:
The Last Caretaker comes to XBOX available to play Day One with XBOX Game Pass in Spring 2027, alongside 1.0 on PC. More than 400,000 copies sold. Around 50 hours average playtime. Seven updates shipped so far.

Next: Update 6.0 in early October.
Then the road continues toward Spring 2027.
And when we reach 1.0: We do not stop.

Wishlist on XBOX: ‎‎https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p9qj0cnbzg8


1.0 is a milestone. Not the end.
Continue the directive.

Buy The Last Caretaker now on: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1783560/The_Last_Caretaker/

Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/the-last-caretaker-51dfcc

Join our Discord: discord.gg/channel37  

For more news and updates, subscribe to our YouTube and Twitch channels for weekly developer livestreams, and follow us on X, Bluesky, and Instagram.
